description:
## Features

### YouTube
- **Add to queue:** new patch with three Feed settings. `Override feed flyout queue button` (on by default) makes the feed flyout `Play next in queue` open the RVX queue. `Add feed flyout queue menu item` (on by default) adds an `Add to RVX queue` flyout item. `Premium-style queue` (off by default) keeps the queue on the device, plays the queued videos one after another on its own, and has a queue sheet with drag reordering, also opened from the Save to Watch later player button. When the patch is applied and one of its queue options is on, it takes over the flyout queue entry, and the older `Override Play next in queue` setting of Hook download actions only applies when they are off. Needs YouTube 21.05 or newer; on older versions it is skipped with a warning. Ported from Morphe.
- **Return YouTube Dislike:** two new settings (off by default) show the like count and the like percentage on the right side of feed video thumbnails. Ported from Morphe.
- **Navigation bar:** new `Disable toolbar navigation tabs` setting (on by default) keeps Subscriptions in the navigation bar when YouTube moves it to a tab at the top of Home. Needs YouTube 21.35 or newer; on older versions it is skipped with a warning. Ported from Morphe.
- **Hide comments components:** new `Hide 'No comments yet' message` and `Hide live chat scroll to bottom button` settings (both off by default). Ported from Morphe.

### YouTube Music
- **Playback speed:** new slider (25-300%, in Video settings) sets the speed used for all tracks and applies within about a second while a track is playing. At 100% the app's own speed, such as the podcast speed, is kept. `Change pitch with speed` now follows the slider and takes effect right away. Ported from Morphe.

## Compatibility
- YouTube: **21.39.525, 21.13.164, 20.05.46**.
- YouTube Music: **9.40.51, 9.15.51, 8.30.54**.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/compare/v1.13.0...v1.14.0)
